_meta.description: Virtues taxonomy link_* census - URL -> probe verdict. Keys are the RAW CSV strings (no normalization, ordinal comparison in the guard). The guard (VirtuesWikipediaLinkCensusGuardTests) asserts every wikipedia-host link_* value of the corpus appears here with a verdict, and burns the dead-cell budget down to 0.
_meta.probe: GET, redirects followed, 3 retries, witness fr:Sophisme every 40 URLs (fail-closed) - wiki_census.py
_meta.regeneration: re-probe per wiki_census.py discipline, then regenerate this file; a re-encoded URL counts as a new key and turns the guard red until probed (fail-closed by design)
_meta.scope_rule: absolute URI with host == wikipedia.org or host ending .wikipedia.org - host-based, so the #1851 wayback mirror (web.archive.org host) is out of scope by construction
